nodes.label: Path Alias @/* -> src/*
nodes.rationale: The @/* alias maps to ./src/* in both tsconfig and vite.config, allowing absolute-style imports throughout the codebase without relative path traversal

nodes.label: Vite Dev Proxy to Backend (localhost:8000)
nodes.rationale: All /api requests in dev are proxied to http://localhost:8000 — decouples frontend dev server from backend, enabling CORS-free local development
